sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Utter indifference to pain or possible death.
Apathetic, depressed, ivith sleepiness.

662

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Stitching pain, supraorbital; worse, left side,
evening, motion. Throbbing over orbits. Congestion
to head; tired feeling in nape. Corysa. Sensation of
drunkenness with constant endeavor to go left-wards.
Left-sided trigeminal neuralgia, especially supraorbital.
Violent eye pains.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Hot stitches deep in eyeball. Ciliary neu-
ralgia; worse, left side. Photophobia. Exophthalmos,
worse reading and writing. Increased intraocular
pressure.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Difficult swallowing. Nausea, heartburn ;
full feeling not relieved by eructation.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
Impulse weak; pulse less frequent. Palpi-
tation with anxiety. Peculiar anxious suggestive ap-
preciation of heart’s action.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, at night, mental exertion, left
side.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare* .Saponin. (Tired, indif-
ferent. Pain in left temple, eye, photophobia, hot
stitches deep in eye. Fifth nerve affections. Migraine.
Much pain before the menstrual flow ; severe sore
throat, worse right side; tonsils swollen, worse in warm
room.)

Compare, also: Verbose.; Coccul. (both containing
Saponin). Quillaya; Senega; Grindel. (contains Sa-
ponin).
